releases.notes:
A standalone Fabric implementation of the Interdiction Torch from Equivalent Exchange: a force field that pushes hostile mobs away and deflects projectiles.

This is an independent mod. It does not require ProjectE or Equivalent Exchange, and is not affiliated with either project.

## Features

- Floor and wall mounted forms, placed by a single item
- Light level 14, same as the vanilla torch
- 12-block force field that pushes hostile mobs away; push strength decreases with distance
- Deflects projectiles that approach the torch
- Custom violet flame particles

## Requirements

| Component     | Version               |
| ------------- | --------------------- |
| Minecraft     | 26.3                  |
| Fabric Loader | 0.20.1 or later       |
| Fabric API    | 0.165.2+26.3 or later |
| Java          | 25                    |

## Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 26.3
2. Place Fabric API and `InterdictionTorchStandalone-0.1.0.jar` into `mods/`
3. Start the game

## Recipe

```
 A       A = Amethyst Cluster
 S       S = Stick
 S
```

## Notes

- An optional 128x texture pack is bundled and disabled by default; enable it from the resource pack screen. It ships diffuse, normal and LabPBR specular maps; the latter two require a shader pack with PBR support
- The force field affects hostile mobs only; players and passive mobs are unaffected

## Links

- Source: https://github.com/RiBunsyou/InterdictionTorchStandalone
- Full changelog: https://github.com/RiBunsyou/InterdictionTorchStandalone/commits/main

# 禁止火把 · 独立版 v0.1.0

《等价交换》中禁止火把的独立 Fabric 实现。放置后生成力场，推开敌对生物并偏转弹射物。

本模组为独立实现，不需要 ProjectE 或等价交换本体，与这两个项目无隶属关系。

## 特性

- 落地与贴墙两种形态，由一个物品放置
- 光照等级 14，与原版火把一致
- 力场半径 12 格，推开敌对生物，推力随距离递减
- 偏转靠近火把的弹射物
- 自定义紫色火焰粒子

## 环境要求

| 组件          | 版本                |
| ------------- | ------------------- |
| Minecraft     | 26.3                |
| Fabric Loader | 0.20.1 或更高       |
| Fabric API    | 0.165.2+26.3 或更高 |
| Java          | 25                  |

## 安装

1. 安装 Fabric Loader 26.3
2. 将 Fabric API 与 `InterdictionTorchStandalone-0.1.0.jar` 放入 `mods/` 目录
3. 启动游戏

## 合成

```
 A       A = 紫水晶簇
 S       S = 木棍
 S
```

## 说明

- 内置一套 128× 高清贴图，默认关闭，可在资源包界面启用。包含漫反射、法线与 LabPBR 高光；后两者需要光影开启 PBR 才会生效
- 力场只作用于敌对生物，玩家与友好生物不受影响
